description: This file contains partial class definitions, interfaces, and extension methods related to Orleans ADO.NET grain storage configuration, options, and storage implementation. It includes classes for storage options, validators, storage factory, and storage-related interfaces and classes, indicating it is a core source file for Orleans ADO.NET storage integration.

classes.name: AdoNetGrainStorageOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for ADO.NET grain storage, including connection string, serializer, hasher, and initialization stage.

classes.name: AdoNetGrainStorageOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validator class for AdoNetGrainStorageOptions to ensure configuration correctness.

classes.name: DefaultAdoNetGrainStorageOptionsHashPickerConfigurator
classes.description: Post-configuration class for setting up default hash picker options.

classes.name: AdoNetGrainStorage
classes.description: Implementation of grain storage using ADO.NET, supporting read, write, and clear operations, and participating in silo lifecycle.

classes.name: AdoNetGrainStorageFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of AdoNetGrainStorage.

classes.name: IStorageHasherPicker
classes.description: Interface for selecting hash providers based on storage and grain context.

classes.name: Orleans3CompatibleStorageHashPicker
classes.description: Hash picker compatible with Orleans 3 hashing strategy.

classes.name: RelationalStorageProviderQueries
classes.description: Holds SQL queries for storage operations.

classes.name: StorageHasherPicker
classes.description: Implementation of IStorageHasherPicker that manages a collection of hash providers.

methods.name: UseOrleans3CompatibleHasher
methods.description: Configures the options to use Orleans 3 compatible hashing.

methods.name: AddAdoNetGrainStorage
methods.description: Extension method to add ADO.NET grain storage to the service collection or silo builder.

methods.name: AddAdoNetGrainStorageAsDefault
methods.description: Extension method to add ADO.NET grain storage as the default storage provider.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an AdoNetGrainStorage instance using the service provider and storage name.

methods.name: Hash
methods.description: Computes a hash value for the given byte array.

methods.name: PickHasher
methods.description: Selects an appropriate hasher based on context.

methods.name: RelationalStorageProviderQueries
methods.description: Constructor initializing SQL queries for storage operations.
